newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed 0.31 percent higher in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 597.48 from 595.65 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 934,000 dinars against 1.8 million dinars.
UBCI bank was up 1.64 dinar to 56.5 dinars. Insurance company Astree up 1.44 dinar to 17.61 dinars.
BIAT bank was down 1.82 dinar to 58.96 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
